headline: Androulakis: 120 installments, VAT up to €20,000 and unseizable account – The plan for small and medium-sized businesses | News
summary: The Greek opposition leader Androulakis outlined measures for small and medium-sized businesses, covering taxes, debts, financing and energy costs. Proposals include 120 instalments and VAT up to €20,000.
why: SME measures on tax, debt and energy costs shape credit conditions and profitability for a large share of Greek employers.
